'''Pash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] that had seen a series of mishaps and hard knocks that ironically kept him from being [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was destroyed by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Working for [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], he flew cargo for the gangster to and from [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the ''[[Ao Var]]''.<ref name="Pash" />
